issues.description: Prohibited template placeholder: 'url = ""  # CI fills this'. Code-style section 5 explicitly lists this pattern as unfinished code. The url field (recipe repository URL) should be filled by the adapter, not left for CI.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the empty url with the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/<org>/<repo>/-/tree/main/archives/l/lzip/1.25". Remove the '# CI fills this' comment.

issues.description: Missing required 'name' field. Code-style section 14 requires manifest.yaml to include 'name: <package_name>' as the first field. The file starts directly with 'version' without declaring the package name.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'name: lzip' as the first line of manifest.yaml, before 'version: "1.25"'.

issues.description: Uses nested 'build.system: autotools' structure instead of the flat 'build_system: autotools' field specified in code-style section 14. The standard shows build_system as a top-level key, not nested under a 'build' object.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the nested 'build:\n  system: autotools' with a flat 'build_system: autotools' at the top level, consistent with the code-style standard.

issues.description: Unfilled template placeholders '（待填写）' remain in the '对话 #1' conversation record section. Both '结果' and '发现的问题' fields are unfilled. While notes.md is documentation rather than code, these placeholders indicate incomplete progress records.
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill in the '结果' and '发现的问题' fields for 对话 #1, or remove the placeholder conversation entry if it was not actually used.

issues.description: Table formatting issue in section 四 (源码修改清单): the table headers are '文件 | 原因 | 方式 | 补丁状态' (4 columns) but the content rows use '文件 | 大小 | 说明' (3 columns) — a mismatch. The content appears to be deliverables data misplaced from section 五. Additionally, no actual source modifications are listed despite the table existing (lzip needs no patches).
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the misplaced deliverables rows from section 四. If no source files were modified, replace the table with '无源码修改（lzip 通过 configure 参数适配，无需补丁）'. Fix section 五 to have proper headers and content without duplicate rows.

issues.description: Inconsistent final status: section 六 (结束记录) states '最终状态: success' while the final line states '最终状态: built'. The manifest.yaml uses 'status: built'. These should be consistent — 'success' refers to the build outcome, while 'built' is the manifest status label. The inconsistency may confuse readers.
issues.fix_suggestion: Align the notes.md final status with the manifest.yaml status. Use 'built' consistently as the manifest status, and clarify that 'success' refers to the build process outcome if both terms are needed.

issues.description: 'def requirements(self): pass' is an unnecessary method when the package has no Conan dependencies. lzip has no Conan recipe dependencies. The empty method adds noise without functionality.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the 'def requirements(self): pass' method entirely. Conan does not require this method to be defined when there are no dependencies.

issues.description: The Tsinghua mirror URL 'https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/savannah/releases/lzip/lzip-1.25.tar.gz' returned HTTP 404 during testing, indicating the mirror path may be incorrect or the file is not mirrored at this path. The official savannah URL is present as a fallback and the file exists there (confirmed via directory listing), so Conan will still download correctly. However, the 404 wastes a network request.
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify the correct Tsinghua mirror path for savannah downloads, or remove the mirror URL and keep only the official savannah URL. CI can handle mirror fallback for GitHub URLs automatically; for non-GitHub sources like savannah, verify mirror availability manually.

=== P2 Code Style (2 issues) ===

=== P3 Suggestions (6 issues) ===

=== Cross-reference with ConanCenter ===
Compared against ConanCenterIndex lzip recipe (versions 1.21-1.23). The audited recipe uses a different compiler-handling approach: instead of patches (ConanCenter's 'any-compiler.patch'), it passes 'CXX={cxx}' as a configure argument in generate(). Both approaches are valid. The audited approach is documented with E095 reference and is cleaner (no patches needed). License 'GPL-2.0+' is equivalent to ConanCenter's 'GPL-v2-or-later'.
